# bioexcel/biobb_io/pdb_cluster_zip

## Summary

This class is a wrapper for downloading a PDB cluster from the Protein Data Bank.

Wrapper for the Protein Data Bank in Europe, the Protein Data Bank and the MMB PDB mirror for downloading a PDB cluster.

Nextflow adapter of the [PdbClusterZip](https://biobb-io.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html#module-api.pdb_cluster_zip) building block of [biobb_io](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_io) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_IO_PDB_CLUSTER_ZIP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_io/pdb_cluster_zip'

workflow {
    BIOBB_IO_PDB_CLUSTER_ZIP(channel.of([id: 'sample']))
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path to the ZIP file containing the output PDB files |
| `versions_biobb_io` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_io', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of PdbClusterZip properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_zip_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_io container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_IO_PDB_CLUSTER_ZIP' {
        ext.properties = [cluster: 50]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pdb_code` | string | null | RSCB PDB code. |
| `filter` | string | "[ATOM, MODEL, ENDMDL]" | Array of groups to be kept. If value is None or False no filter will be applied. All the possible values are defined in the official PDB specification (http://www.wwpdb.org/documentation/file-format-content/format33/v3.3.html) |
| `cluster` | integer | 90 | Sequence Similarity Cutoff. Values: 50, 70, 90, 95. |
| `api_id` | string | "pdbe" | Identifier of the PDB REST API from which the PDB structure will be downloaded. Values: pdbe, pdb, mmb. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
